paragraphs.text: The CEO repeated net revenue retention of 112% and said the top ten customers account for 31% of revenue.
The CFO explained that implementation and training fees are bundled into the first-year subscription invoice.
Management plans a 6% list-price increase in 2027 and a predictive-maintenance module priced as an add-on.
The largest customer is a pan-European logistics group; management described the relationship as strategic.
